name: qwen-copilot-chat
description: Use Qwen models from Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (DashScope) directly in GitHub Copilot Chat - with streaming, thinking mode, tool calling and image input.

qwen-copilot.baseUrl.markdownDescription:
Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible Qwen endpoint. Use the value shown in your console:

- QwenCloud Token Plan (`sk-sp-…` key): `https://token-plan.maas.qwencloudapi.com/compatible-mode/v1`
- QwenCloud Pay-As-You-Go (`sk-…` key): `https://maas.qwencloudapi.com/compatible-mode/v1`
- Model Studio / DashScope China: `https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`
- Model Studio / DashScope Singapore: `https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`

The key type and the base URL must match - Token Plan and Pay-As-You-Go keys are not interchangeable. `/chat/completions` is appended automatically when missing.

[Set API Key](command:qwen-copilot.setApiKey) · [Clear API Key](command:qwen-copilot.clearApiKey) · [Get API Key](command:qwen-copilot.getApiKey)

qwen-copilot.apiKey.markdownDescription: Optional fallback for the Qwen API key. The key is normally stored securely via **Qwen: Set API Key** (SecretStorage). Only set this for automation or CI - settings are stored in plain text.

qwen-copilot.maxTokens.description: Maximum number of output tokens per request. Set to 0 to use the API default.

qwen-copilot.temperature.description: Sampling temperature. -1 leaves the value to the API default.

qwen-copilot.preserveThinking.markdownDescription: Replay previous `reasoning_content` back to the model on follow-up turns (`preserve_thinking`). Only supported by some Qwen models; enabling it may increase input tokens.

qwen-copilot.enabledModels.markdownDescription: Limit the model picker to this list of model IDs (case-insensitive). Leave empty to show all built-in models. Example: `["qwen3.8-max", "qwen3.7-plus"]`.

apiModel.description: API model ID sent to the endpoint.

name.description: Display name in the model picker.

tooltip.description: Tooltip shown in the model picker.

maxInputTokens.description: Maximum input tokens reported to Copilot.

maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum output tokens reported to Copilot.

imageInput.description: Whether the model accepts image input.

toolCalling.description: Whether the model supports tool calling.

thinking.description: Whether the model supports a thinking / reasoning mode.

qwen-copilot.extraModels.markdownDescription:
Add additional models to the picker (for example Qwen models that are not built in).

```json
[
  {
    "id": "my-model",
    "apiModel": "qwen3.5-flash",
    "name": "My Qwen",
    "maxInputTokens": 262144,
    "maxOutputTokens": 32768,
    "imageInput": true,
    "toolCalling": true,
    "thinking": true
  }
]
```

id.description: Unique model ID used by VS Code.

apiModel.description: Model ID sent to the API.

name.description: Display name in the model picker.

detail.description: Short detail text shown next to the model name.

qwen-copilot.requestHeaders.markdownDescription: Extra HTTP headers sent with every chat completion request (for example for proxies or gateways).

markdownEnumDescriptions: Adds privacy-safe request metadata (model, message counts, tool counts, timing).
Adds full request bodies. Warning: contains prompt content.
qwen-copilot.debugMode.markdownDescription: Controls what is written to the **Qwen** output channel. Use [`Qwen: Show Logs`](command:qwen-copilot.showLogs) to open it.
